clauses.text: Subject state machine: `draft` becomes `review` at submission and `review` becomes `approved` when the last required approval lands; a rejection or invalidation returns the subject from `review` (or from `approved`, `scheduled` or `blocked`) to `draft` through an audited transition while the review stays `rejected` or `invalidated`; `approved` becomes `active` or `scheduled`; `scheduled` becomes `active` at execution or `blocked` when execution fails terminally; `blocked` becomes `active` or `scheduled` through a new activation command while its review is still `approved` and current; `active` becomes `superseded` in the transaction that activates a newer version of the lineage, or `retired`; `superseded` and `retired` are terminal; and the review states are `open` to `approved`, `rejected` or `invalidated` and `approved` to `invalidated`, with assignment create and revoke never changing the review state.

clauses.text: Pattern update `accept`: for each listed instance a listed path that is not a collision adopts the target value, a local override on a path the target did not change is retained, every collision takes the explicit `yours` or `theirs` choice (on a `props` collision `theirs` takes the target `props` and `yours` keeps the override; on a `structure` collision `theirs` adopts the target's block identity and `children` there, keeping that path's override only when the target left its `props` unchanged), and the command appends an `active` row pinned to the target version whose kept overrides each name a node of the target tree;
